lines: and your phone has no signal.
First instinct: pry the doors open.
Four calm moves get you out. Move three kills the biggest fear.
Sometimes you're right at a floor.
The lift has its own bell and intercom.
You will not run out of air.
Lifts have air vents built in.
That roof hatch? It's for rescuers, not action heroes.

post.youtube_description:
If a lift stops between floors, don't pry the doors open: the car may not be at a door opening, and a stuck lift could start moving again. Press door open (sometimes you're at a floor), press the alarm or use the intercom, breathe (lifts have air vents, so you won't run out of air) and stay inside until trained help arrives. The roof hatch is for rescuers only.
